description: Shiori's special events in SERIFU/EVENT_FU.BIN (load address 0x80198000, game-internals 6e/6j). Pilot: scene 2, the early-morning walk to school (event-table entry 7, master list 0x6F4). Box order: 0x62C (player thought), 0x2AA8 + 0x64C (Shiori; the two strings share one 3-line box), 0x668 (player), 0x6A8 (player thought). 178 of 188 pooled bytes used. Trigger: needs Shiori affection >= 61 and a second score >= 50, then about a 1% roll, once per game, so testing forces it with tools/emu/force_event.py (docs/testing.md, 'Forcing a girl event'). Other EVENT_FU scenes are not translated yet.

lines.original:
たまには
早起きもいいなぁ。
lines.text:
Up early for once.
It's nice.)

lines.original:
おはよう。
早いね、今日は。

おはよう、詩織。
たまには、
早起きの日もあるよ。
lines.text:
Morning, Shiori.
Even I'm up early
sometimes.

lines.original:
今日は楽しく登校できた。
早起きは三文の得とは、
よく言ったもんだぜ。
lines.text:
Fun walk to school today.
Early bird gets the worm.
How true.)
